title: A title bar on the timeline has a right-click menu
goal: Right-clicking a title or any placed layer on the timeline offers what you would do to it there (start here, end here, fade, delete), the way a clip bar already does, so the Time section can drop its two buttons.
notes: Found in the-video-properties-look-like-the-rest-of-the-d: SpeedInspector.placedInTime still has a Playhead row with Start Here and End Here because a placed layer bar has no .contextMenu (clip bars get TimelineClipMenu in ClipPiecesBar). EditorState startPlacedLayerHere/endPlacedLayerHere/setPlacedLayerFade already exist.
acceptance: Right-clicking a title bar on the timeline opens a menu with Start at Playhead, End at Playhead, a Fade submenu, Duplicate and Delete
The Start Here and End Here buttons leave the Time section
A walk right-clicks a title bar, chooses End at Playhead, and reads the On screen row back
